name: F5 Certified Technology Specialist, BIG-IP APM

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The required F5 administrator credential and concentrated authentication scope fit an APM specialization; three years of experience add depth, but knowledge-only testing and limited recognition do not imply broad IAM seniority.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: APM authentication expertise built on F5 Administrator fits a focused IAM specialization. The three-year profile is useful context, but a multiple-choice vendor exam and limited independent recognition do not establish broad identity seniority.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded authentication-specific BIG-IP extension requires the administrator credential, making it a clear specialty branch. Its multiple-choice-only assessment limits practical assurance without implying a higher general career rank.
